metadata.description: Miami on an old CRT at sunset: OpenFreeMap's arterials drawn into a render target in neon colours, split through a lens so each colour channel drifts apart toward the edges, and blurred into glows; the other streets apart, unsplit, fading into the distance as the map tilts so the far city sinks into a pink haze; a striped synthwave sun lying on the Atlantic seen from above and, once the map tilts, standing on its horizon in extruded slabs, cut where the horizon meets it for each quarter zoom and the pitch, its stripes narrowing toward the sea, with thin magenta and cyan fringes off its rims and a soft corona behind; its reflection a label of dashes at its foot, upright on the screen and drawn through the sea's mask, so it lies under the sun from anywhere; a grid on the sea turned toward the sun, so that its lines race to it, tinted by a screen-space gradient; the coast traced in pink, the surf the land's blurred mask; scanlines banded from a gradient, a vignette ramped from a radial one, under drifting static.
